lines.zh: 我从街机厅那头走过来。
lines.en: I come from the far end of the arcade.

lines.zh: 我的红白壳在灯下很显眼。
lines.en: My red and white shell stands out under the lights.
I shuffle and the floor creaks.

lines.zh: 我的气球道具在身后晃。
lines.en: My balloon prop sways behind me.
I walk around an arcade cabinet.

lines.zh: 我抬脚的时候会停一下。
lines.en: I pause each time I lift a foot.

lines.zh: 我走到一半，忘了要去哪。
lines.en: Halfway there, I forget where I was going.
I drag one foot across the floor.

lines.zh: 我的影子在机器上滑过。
lines.en: My shadow slides across the machines.
I walk very slowly.
I head for the door near you.
I stand with empty hands.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛里有两盏小灯。
lines.en: Two little lights sit in my eyes.

lines.zh: 眼睛的红光慢慢暗下去。
lines.en: The red light in my eyes fades slowly.

lines.zh: 街机的屏幕在我脸上闪。
lines.en: The arcade screen flickers on my face.
I tilt my head at a machine.
I am not looking for anyone.
A finger twitches.
I am used to the noise here.
I stand and listen.
I glance at you, then elsewhere.
You do not look like a regular.
I tilt my head and say nothing.
Are you looking at my shell?
Strangers are not very welcome here.

lines.zh: 我的电路板松了，动作卡了一下。
lines.en: My circuit board slipped and my arm stalled.
Do not touch the machines.
The door is over there.
I rock and hold.
There is a mark on my shell.
I step back and stop.
I do not feel much pain.
I raise my hand and a joint clicks.
My balloon flies off.

lines.zh: 我的脸歪着，转过来更歪。
lines.en: My face is askew. Turning makes it worse.
I am not angry; I will simply respond.
Batteries are what I want.
Why are you holding it up?
My jaw is not for eating.

lines.zh: 你不如给它找个地方放。
lines.en: You should find somewhere to put it.
Put it away.
I prefer the sound of the machines.
I will not trade for this.

lines.zh: 你手里的零件，能给我吗？
lines.en: Those spare parts in your hand — may I have them?
The balloon string tangles on your shoulder.
I am not heavy, but not light either.

lines.zh: 我的壳磕在你身上，响了。
lines.en: My shell knocks against you and rings.
I catch a machine beside me.
My balloon swings wildly.
I right myself and walk on.
Watch where you go next time.

lines.zh: 抱歉，我的关节不太灵活。
lines.en: Sorry, my joints aren't very flexible.
There used to be more than me here.

lines.zh: 我把气球举给别的人看。
lines.en: I hold up my balloon for someone else.
We stand side by side a while.

lines.zh: 机器的光在我们身上跳。
lines.en: The machine light jumps across us.
I tug my companion's hand.
There is nothing else for us to do.
The door opens and closes.
We go back to our places.
The arcade keeps humming.
A doll doesn't need another half.
I bend and pick it up.
I set it on the counter.
It would be stepped on down there.
It takes me two tries to hold it.
I look at it and do not understand.
I put it away.
This can go on the shelf.
I am not good at picking things up.
My movements suddenly quicken.
I know where you are standing.
The arcade light stutters.
I do not plan to call anyone.
I walk toward you.
The door is already closed.

lines.zh: 电路板响了一声，我醒了。
lines.en: A circuit board clicks; I wake up.
Do not back behind the machines.
There is no exit for you here.
My steps are speeding up.
I raise the balloon in my hand.
I am done going slowly.

lines.zh: 我沿着机器一排排过来。
lines.en: I come down the row of machines.

lines.zh: 屏幕把你的影子照在墙上。
lines.en: The screens throw your shadow on the wall.
I stop with my head tilted.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在噪音里很明显。
lines.en: Your breathing stands out in the noise.
I step over the cables.
I switch one machine off.
The corridor darkens.
I know your footsteps.
I go around to the row behind you.
The door handle rattles.

lines.zh: 我不急，这里只有一条路。
lines.en: No hurry; there is only one way out.

lines.zh: 我的手臂碰到一排按钮。
lines.en: My arm brushes a row of buttons.
Another light goes out.
You have backed up three times and gone nowhere.
I am very close.
My shell scrapes the wall.
Where else can you go?
The floor creaks once.
I never chase; I simply wait.
I slap you with an open hand.
I am faster than I look.
My shell hits your shoulder.
I grab your arm.

lines.zh: 这一下不算重，可很突然。
lines.en: That was not heavy, but it was sudden.
I shove you into a machine.

lines.zh: 我的手指卡在你衣服上。
lines.en: My fingers catch in your clothes.
My plastic palm presses your chest.
I raise my hand and bring it down.
My joints are loud.
My arm rises very slowly.
You blocked it but did not get clear.
Pink plastic fingers squeeze tight.
I shake out my hand; the joint clicks.
My nails leave white streaks on the iron.
You cannot stand steady.
A mechanical joint sticks for a moment.

lines.zh: 街机厅里多了一个影子。
lines.en: There is one more shadow in the arcade.

lines.zh: 我从展示台后面走出来。
lines.en: I step out from behind the display.

lines.zh: 灯亮了一下，我就在那里。
lines.en: The light comes on and I am there.
I am holding a balloon.

lines.zh: 这层楼以前没这么安静。
lines.en: This floor was not this quiet before.
Pale blue plastic glints in the dark.

lines.zh: 我踩到一根电缆，停了一下。
lines.en: I step on a cable and pause.
The machines get a little quieter.
I stand at the mouth of the hall.
The door stands open behind me.
I look up at the lights.
There should be more people here.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的壳，塑料在滴。
lines.en: Fire catches my shell and plastic drips.

lines.zh: 我从台上摔下来，弹了两下。
lines.en: I fall off the stage and bounce twice.

lines.zh: 水进了我的关节，动作变慢。
lines.en: Water gets into my joints and I slow down.
The blast throws me to the doorway.
An arrow pins into my chest.

lines.zh: 一阵光，我的眼睛闪了一下。
lines.en: A flash of magic and my eyes flicker.
My power is almost gone.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我的动作乱跳。
lines.en: Lightning hits and my movements jerk.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，气球飘在上面。
lines.en: I fall, and the balloon floats above.
